role.zh: 月之暗面 Moonshot AI 创始人兼 CEO

why.en: Co-first-author of Transformer-XL and XLNet — the strongest academic pedigree among China's model founders. Kimi entered through ultra-long context; K3 is now the largest open-weight model publicly available anywhere.
why.zh: Transformer-XL 与 XLNet 共同一作，学术出身最硬的中国大模型创业者。Kimi 以超长上下文切入市场；K3 现已是全球公开可得的最大开放权重模型。

title.en: Kimi K2.5 and Agent Swarm: scheduling hundreds of agents in parallel
title.zh: Kimi K2.5 与 Agent Swarm：并行调度成百上千个 Agent

note.en: Also covers applying attention along the depth axis as an architectural change.
note.zh: 同场还讲了把注意力机制应用到深度轴的架构创新。

title.en: AGI-Next panel with Tang Jie, Shunyu Yao and Junyang Lin
title.zh: AGI-Next 圆桌：与唐杰、姚顺雨、林俊旸同台

note.en: His framing there: the essence of an agent is a search problem.
note.zh: 他在会上的论断：Agent 的本质是一个搜索问题。

title.en: XLNet: generalized autoregressive pretraining
title.zh: XLNet：广义自回归预训练

title.en: Kimi K3 open weights — 2.8T parameters, 1M context
title.zh: Kimi K3 开放权重 —— 2.8 万亿参数，100 万上下文

note.en: The largest open-weight model publicly available.
note.zh: 当前公开可得的最大开放权重模型。

title.en: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
title.zh: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence

note.en: Moonshot's flagship technical report on Kimi K3, a 2.8T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104B activated parameters, native vision and a 1M-token context window.
note.zh: 月之暗面 Kimi K3 技术报告：2.8 万亿参数的混合专家模型，激活参数 1040 亿，原生支持视觉，上下文窗口达 100 万 token。

title.en: Attention Residuals
title.zh: Attention Residuals

note.en: Kimi Team report arguing that the fixed unit weights of PreNorm residual connections cause uncontrolled hidden-state growth with depth, and proposing a reweighted alternative.
note.zh: Kimi 团队技术报告：指出 PreNorm 残差连接以固定单位权重累加各层输出，会导致隐状态随深度失控增长，并提出重新加权的替代方案。

title.en: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence
title.zh: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence

note.en: Technical report on Kimi K2.5, Moonshot's open-source multimodal agentic model that jointly optimises text and vision.
note.zh: Kimi K2.5 技术报告：月之暗面的开源多模态智能体模型，对文本与视觉进行联合优化。

title.en: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
title.zh: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture

note.en: Kimi Linear, a hybrid linear-attention architecture that Moonshot reports outperforming full attention under matched comparisons across short- and long-context settings.
note.zh: Kimi Linear：月之暗面提出的混合线性注意力架构，在短上下文与长上下文的公平对比中均超过全注意力。

title.en: Kimi-Dev: Agentless Training as Skill Prior for SWE-Agents
title.zh: Kimi-Dev: Agentless Training as Skill Prior for SWE-Agents

note.en: Kimi-Dev shows that agentless training can serve as a skill prior for SWE agents, bridging the two dominant approaches on SWE-bench.
note.zh: Kimi-Dev：论证无智能体训练可作为软件工程智能体的技能先验，衔接 SWE-bench 上两类主流方法。

title.en: 113. 和杨植麟时隔1年的对话：K2、Agentic LLM、缸中之脑和“站在无限的开端”
title.zh: 113. 和杨植麟时隔1年的对话：K2、Agentic LLM、缸中之脑和“站在无限的开端”

note.en: In this interview with tech journalist Zhang Xiaojun, a year after their last conversation, Yang Zhilin discusses building Kimi K2, his views on agentic LLMs, and his philosophical takes on AI cognition.
note.zh: 在与科技记者张小珺时隔一年的对话中，杨植麟谈及Kimi K2的研发、他对Agentic LLM等技术问题的判断，以及对AI认知问题的哲学思考。

title.en: OpenCUA: Open Foundations for Computer-Use Agents
title.zh: OpenCUA: Open Foundations for Computer-Use Agents

note.en: OpenCUA, a HKU–Moonshot collaboration releasing open foundations, data and models for computer-use agents whose commercial counterparts stay closed.
note.zh: OpenCUA：港大与月之暗面合作，为电脑操作智能体开源基础框架、数据与模型，与闭源的商业方案形成对照。

title.en: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
title.zh: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence

note.en: Kimi K2, a 1T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 32B activated parameters, introducing the MuonClip optimizer.
note.zh: Kimi K2：1 万亿参数的混合专家模型，激活参数 320 亿，并提出 MuonClip 优化器。

title.en: OJBench: A Competition Level Code Benchmark For Large Language Models
title.zh: OJBench: A Competition Level Code Benchmark For Large Language Models

note.en: OJBench, a competition-level code benchmark built from olympiad judge problems to probe the limits of LLM code reasoning.
note.zh: OJBench：基于竞赛判题题目构建的竞赛级代码基准，用于检验大模型代码推理能力的上限。

title.en: Learning to Plan Before Answering: Self-Teaching LLMs to Learn Abstract Plans for Problem Solving
title.zh: Learning to Plan Before Answering: Self-Teaching LLMs to Learn Abstract Plans for Problem Solving

note.en: LEPA teaches an LLM to write an abstract plan before answering, using its own synthetic data for post-training.
note.zh: LEPA：让大模型在作答前先生成抽象计划，并用自生成的合成数据进行后训练。

title.en: Kimi-Audio Technical Report
title.zh: Kimi-Audio Technical Report

note.en: Kimi-Audio technical report, covering Moonshot's open-source audio foundation model for understanding, generation and conversation.
note.zh: Kimi-Audio 技术报告：介绍月之暗面开源的音频基础模型，涵盖音频理解、生成与对话。

title.en: Kimina-Prover Preview: Towards Large Formal Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Kimina-Prover Preview: Towards Large Formal Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Kimina-Prover, a reinforcement-learning-trained model for formal theorem proving built with Numina, extending Moonshot's reasoning work into Lean.
note.zh: Kimina-Prover：与 Numina 合作、以强化学习训练的形式化定理证明模型，将月之暗面的推理研究延伸到 Lean。

title.en: Kimi-VL Technical Report
title.zh: Kimi-VL Technical Report

note.en: Technical report for Kimi-VL, Moonshot's open-source Mixture-of-Experts vision-language model with long-context and agent capabilities.
note.zh: Kimi-VL 技术报告，介绍月之暗面开源的 MoE 视觉语言模型，具备长上下文理解与智能体能力。

title.en: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training
title.zh: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training

note.en: Moonshot's demonstration that the Muon optimizer scales to large LLM training, the optimizer work that later underpinned K2.
note.zh: 月之暗面证明 Muon 优化器可扩展到大规模语言模型训练，这项优化器工作后来支撑了 K2。

title.en: MoBA: Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs
title.zh: MoBA: Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs

note.en: MoBA applies mixture-of-experts routing to attention blocks to cut the quadratic cost of long-context inference, central to Kimi's long-context positioning.
note.zh: MoBA：将混合专家的路由思想用于注意力分块，降低长上下文推理的二次方开销，是 Kimi 长上下文定位的核心工作。

title.en: Kimi k1.5: Scaling Reinforcement Learning with LLMs
title.zh: Kimi k1.5: Scaling Reinforcement Learning with LLMs

note.en: Kimi k1.5 report on scaling reinforcement learning with LLMs, Moonshot's first reasoning model release.
note.zh: Kimi k1.5 报告：探讨大模型强化学习的规模化，是月之暗面首个推理模型的发布。

title.en: 月之暗面杨植麟：创新、长期、第一性
title.zh: 月之暗面杨植麟：创新、长期、第一性

note.en: In a two-hour sit-down interview with early investor Monolith Capital, Yang Zhilin discusses AGI, philosophy, and his commitment to long-term, first-principles entrepreneurship at Moonshot AI.
note.zh: 在与早期投资方砺思资本长达两小时的访谈中，杨植麟谈及AGI、哲学，以及他在月之暗面创业中坚持的长期主义与第一性原理。

title.en: 59. 和杨植麟聊大模型创业这一年：人类理想的增量、有概率的非共识和Sora
title.zh: 59. 和杨植麟聊大模型创业这一年：人类理想的增量、有概率的非共识和Sora

note.en: Yang Zhilin reflects on his first year building Moonshot AI, discussing conviction against consensus opinion and what Sora's release meant for the field.
note.zh: 杨植麟回顾创办月之暗面的第一年，谈及有概率的非共识判断，以及Sora的发布对行业的影响。

title.en: Vol.13 张鹏对谈月之暗面杨植麟：大模型创业需要新的组织范式
title.zh: Vol.13 张鹏对谈月之暗面杨植麟：大模型创业需要新的组织范式

note.en: In this interview with GeekPark's Zhang Peng, Yang Zhilin argues that building large-model companies requires new organizational paradigms, and discusses his path from Transformer-XL and XLNet to founding Moonshot AI.
note.zh: 在极客公园张鹏的访谈中，杨植麟提出大模型创业需要全新的组织范式，并谈及自己从Transformer-XL、XLNet研究到创办月之暗面的历程。

title.en: CodeGeeX: A Pre-Trained Model for Code Generation with Multilingual Benchmarking on HumanEval-X
title.zh: CodeGeeX: A Pre-Trained Model for Code Generation with Multilingual Benchmarking on HumanEval-X

note.en: CodeGeeX, a multilingual pre-trained code generation model with the HumanEval-X benchmark, from his Tsinghua-era collaboration with Jie Tang's group.
note.zh: CodeGeeX：多语言代码生成预训练模型及 HumanEval-X 基准，出自他在清华时期与唐杰团队的合作。

title.en: Learning to Detect Noisy Labels Using Model-Based Features
title.zh: Learning to Detect Noisy Labels Using Model-Based Features

note.en: A method for detecting noisy training labels from model-based features rather than hand-designed heuristics.
note.zh: 提出用基于模型的特征而非人工启发式规则来检测训练数据中的噪声标签。

title.en: A Universal Discriminator for Zero-Shot Generalization
title.zh: A Universal Discriminator for Zero-Shot Generalization

note.en: Argues that a discriminative model can beat the dominant generative approach at zero-shot generalization across tasks.
note.zh: 论证判别式模型在跨任务零样本泛化上可以胜过主流的生成式方法。

title.en: Zero-Label Prompt Selection
title.zh: Zero-Label Prompt Selection

note.en: A method for choosing among natural language prompts without labeled examples, addressing the brittleness of prompt-based cross-task transfer.
note.zh: 提出在没有标注样本的情况下挑选自然语言提示的方法，缓解提示驱动跨任务迁移的不稳定问题。

title.en: Prompt-Based Metric Learning for Few-Shot NER
title.zh: Prompt-Based Metric Learning for Few-Shot NER

note.en: Prompt-based metric learning for few-shot named entity recognition, improving over token-level similarity methods.
note.zh: 面向小样本命名实体识别的提示式度量学习方法，改进了基于词元级相似度的做法。

title.en: Kimi K3 released with open weights — 2.8T parameters
title.zh: Kimi K3 开放权重发布 —— 2.8 万亿参数

body.en: The largest open-weight model publicly available, with a 1M-token context window. Presented at GTC 2026. Moonshot suspended new subscriptions within two days as demand overwhelmed capacity.
body.zh: 当前全球最大的开放权重模型，100 万 token 上下文。于 GTC 2026 发布。上线两天后因需求超出算力承载，Moonshot 暂停新订阅。

title.en: CNN: 'What is China's Kimi K3 and why is the US so rattled by it?'
title.zh: CNN：「中国的 Kimi K3 是什么，美国为何如此紧张？」

body.en: K3 matches or beats leading US models on several tasks, for free. Moonshot valuation ~$20B.
body.zh: K3 在多项任务上匹敌甚至超越美国领先模型，且免费。Moonshot 估值约 200 亿美元。

title.en: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
title.zh: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding

body.en: Coverage described how Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, led by Yang Zhilin, now undercuts rival coding models on price after he turned down an Apple partnership.
body.zh: 报道称，杨植麟拒绝与苹果合作后，其带领的月之暗面Kimi K3在编程模型定价上已低于竞争对手。

title.en: 黄仁勋为何力挺梁文锋、杨植麟？
title.zh: 黄仁勋为何力挺梁文锋、杨植麟？

body.en: A report examined why Nvidia's Jensen Huang has publicly backed Yang Zhilin alongside DeepSeek's Liang Wenfeng.
body.zh: 报道探讨了英伟达黄仁勋为何公开力挺杨植麟与DeepSeek梁文锋。

title.en: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
title.zh: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding

body.en: Yang Zhilin turned down a partnership with Apple, and his Kimi K3 model is now reported to outperform Claude Fable 5 on coding tasks.
body.zh: 杨植麟拒绝了与苹果的合作，其Kimi K3模型据报道在编程任务上已超越Claude Fable 5。

title.en: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
title.zh: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding

body.en: Coverage said Yang Zhilin turned down a deal with Apple, while Moonshot's Kimi K3 is reported to beat Claude Fable 5 on coding benchmarks.
body.zh: 报道称杨植麟拒绝了与苹果的合作，而月之暗面的Kimi K3据称在编程基准测试上超过了Claude Fable 5。

title.en: 杨植麟说过“不急于IPO”，为什么现在又秘密递表了？
title.zh: 杨植麟说过“不急于IPO”，为什么现在又秘密递表了？

body.en: Moonshot AI quietly filed for an IPO despite Yang's earlier statements downplaying the urgency of going public.
body.zh: 尽管杨植麟此前称“不急于IPO”，月之暗面还是秘密递交了上市申请。

title.en: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
title.zh: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding

body.en: Coverage highlighted Yang's decision to turn down an Apple partnership, with Kimi K3 now reportedly undercutting rival models on coding benchmarks.
body.zh: 报道称杨植麟拒绝了与苹果的合作，其Kimi K3在编程基准测试中据称已超越竞争模型。

title.en: 杨植麟，急于短期内IPO
title.zh: 杨植麟，急于短期内IPO

body.en: Yang Zhilin is reportedly pushing for Moonshot AI to IPO in the near term.
body.zh: 据报道，杨植麟正推动月之暗面在短期内实现IPO。

title.en: 杨植麟谈创业最大苦难：每天起床都觉得公司要挂了 创业是一场长期与不确定性博弈的修行，Kimi创始人杨植麟坦言，哪怕身处高光，也要时刻直面生存的焦虑。创业者要“谨慎的乐观”，正视风险，聚焦核心，积极解决问题。#商业认知#人工智能#新质企业家
title.zh: 杨植麟谈创业最大苦难：每天起床都觉得公司要挂了 创业是一场长期与不确定性博弈的修行，Kimi创始人杨植麟坦言，哪怕身处高光，也要时刻直面生存的焦虑。创业者要“谨慎的乐观”，正视风险，聚焦核心，积极解决问题。#商业认知#人工智能#新质企业家

body.en: Yang Zhilin said the hardest part of founding Moonshot is waking up every day feeling the company could fail, describing entrepreneurship as a long fight against uncertainty.
body.zh: 杨植麟表示创办月之暗面最大的苦难是每天醒来都觉得公司可能撑不下去，将创业形容为一场与不确定性长期博弈的修行。

title.en: 月之暗面已递交港股上市申请？创始人杨植麟曾表示“短期内不急于IPO”
title.zh: 月之暗面已递交港股上市申请？创始人杨植麟曾表示“短期内不急于IPO”

body.en: Moonshot AI has reportedly filed for a Hong Kong IPO, despite Yang previously saying there was no urgency to go public.
body.zh: 月之暗面据报已递交港股上市申请，此前杨植麟曾表示短期内不急于IPO。

title.en: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding
title.zh: Yang Zhilin Said No To Apple — Now His Kimi K3 Undercuts Claude Fable 5 On Coding

body.en: Moonshot's Kimi K3 is reported to undercut Claude Fable 5 on coding-task pricing, sharpening price competition among frontier coding models.
body.zh: 据报道，月之暗面的Kimi K3在编程任务定价上低于Claude Fable 5，加剧了前沿编程模型间的价格竞争。

title.en: TIME百大AI人物 中国AI新势力杨植麟、张鹏亮相
title.zh: TIME百大AI人物 中国AI新势力杨植麟、张鹏亮相

body.en: Yang Zhilin was named to TIME's 100 most influential people in AI, alongside Zhipu's Zhang Peng, as part of China's new AI wave.
body.zh: 杨植麟入选TIME全球百大AI人物榜单，与智谱张鹏一同代表中国AI新势力。

title.en: TIME百大AI人物 中国AI新势力杨植麟、张鹏亮相
title.zh: TIME百大AI人物 中国AI新势力杨植麟、张鹏亮相

body.en: Yang Zhilin was named to TIME's 100 most influential people in AI, alongside Zhang Peng, as part of a new wave of Chinese AI leaders.
body.zh: 杨植麟入选《时代》周刊全球100位最具影响力AI人物榜单，与张鹏一同代表新一代中国AI力量。

title.en: 《时代》2026年度AI百大人物：吴泳铭登封面，杨植麟、何庭波等入选，黄仁勋、王兴兴未上榜

body.en: Yang Zhilin was named to TIME's 2026 AI 100 list, one of several Chinese AI leaders recognized alongside figures like Alibaba's Wu Yongming.
body.zh: 杨植麟入选《时代》2026年度AI百大人物榜单，与阿里巴巴吴泳铭等多位中国AI领军人物一同上榜。

body.en: Yang Zhilin was named to TIME's 2026 list of the 100 most influential people in AI, alongside He Tingbo, while Jensen Huang and Wang Xingxing were left off this year's list.

body.en: Yang Zhilin was named to TIME's 2026 AI 100 list, alongside other Chinese AI leaders.
body.zh: 杨植麟入选《时代》2026年度AI百大人物榜单，与多位中国AI领军人物一同上榜。

body.en: Yang Zhilin was named to TIME's 2026 list of the 100 most influential people in AI, alongside He Tingbo; Jensen Huang and Wang Xingxing did not make the list this year.
body.zh: 杨植麟入选《时代》2026年度AI影响力100人榜单，与何庭波一同上榜；黄仁勋、王兴兴未能入选。

body.zh: 报道探讨了杨植麟拒绝苹果邀约、回国创业的选择，并借此分析美国为何难以留住中国AI人才。

body.zh: 月之暗面的Kimi K3据报道在榜单上超越Fable 5登顶第一，是杨植麟旗舰模型的一次具体性能里程碑。

body.en: Moonshot AI raised another ¥14 billion in funding following a public appearance by founder Yang Zhilin, per Chinese venture-finance outlet 投资界 (PEdaily).
body.zh: 据投资界报道，杨植麟公开现身后，月之暗面（Moonshot AI）再获140亿元融资。

title.en: Kimi杨植麟出席总理座谈会，半月内二度亮相《新闻联播》
title.zh: Kimi杨植麟出席总理座谈会，半月内二度亮相《新闻联播》

body.en: Yang Zhilin attended a symposium with China's Premier and appeared on CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo for the second time in two weeks, reflecting high-level recognition of Kimi/Moonshot AI.
body.zh: 杨植麟出席了国务院总理座谈会，并在半月内第二次亮相央视《新闻联播》，反映出Kimi/月之暗面获得高层关注。

title.en: Kimi杨植麟出席总理座谈会，半月内二度亮相《新闻联播》

body.en: Yang Zhilin attended a State Council premier's symposium and appeared on CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo twice within two weeks, reflecting his rising profile in China's policy circles.
body.zh: 杨植麟出席国务院总理座谈会，并在半月内两次亮相央视《新闻联播》，反映其在中国政策圈内地位上升。
